pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly sized polygonal regions with jagged, high-frequency serrated boundaries. Edge angularity exhibits smooth pixel gradients due to motion blur and resolution limits, though the underlying geometry remains sharply angular on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways with a high density of tri-radiate junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, approximately 10-15 pixels wide, and becomes more fragmented toward the lower ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the dorsal neck line exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background, extending from the mid-neck to the shoulder.
